verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents its own terminal CLI, Wally (official per probe-3), which runs small models locally, offline and without an account (docs-6, docs-14), and starts a tool against a model with one command (docs-7). That is a GUI-free runtime path the product itself ships. However, nothing documents server or CI deployment, a daemon or serve mode for the local runtime, or non-interactive operation. Hosted use requires browser sign-in (docs-5, docs-15). The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (docs-4) is RunAnywhere's cloud service, not a self-hosted headless server. missing for 10: documented headless server/daemon mode, CI pipeline usage guidance, non-interactive auth for hosted mode, supported server OS/hardware targets, independent corroboration.
